name: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited
summary: RateGain Travel Technologies Limited, an India-based software-as-a-service provider founded in Noida in 2004, supplies technology to the global hospitality and travel industries across India, North America, Asia-Pacific and Europe. Products include AirGain for airfare pricing intelligence, CarGain for car rental analysis, FerryGain for ferry revenue management, Optima for real-time rate intelligence, and PriceGain and Rate Parity tools.
